import { books } from '../../content.config'

  title: book.data.title,
  author: book.data.author,
  year: book.data.year,
  tags: book.data.tags,
}))

cat > src/components/book-list.kay <<'EOF'
---
import { favorites } from '../favorites'

interface Entry { slug: string, title: string, author: string, year: number, tags: string[] }

const { books, tags } = props<{ books: Entry[], tags: string[] }>()
const selected = signal<string | null>(null)
const shown = memo(() => books.filter(book => selected() === null || book.tags.includes(selected()!)))
---
.my-4.flex.flex-wrap.gap-2(role="group" aria-label="Filter by tag")
  button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected === null ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(null)}) All
  for tag of tags key={tag}
    button(type="button" aria-pressed={selected === tag ? 'true' : 'false'} onClick={() => selected.set(tag)}) {tag}
ul(aria-label="Books")
  for book of shown key={book.slug}
    li.py-1
      a(href={`/books/${book.slug}`}) {book.title}
      |  {book.author}, {book.year}
      if favorites().includes(book.slug)
        |  
        span Favorite
EOF
